task.title: e2e delete-helper hygiene after relocating delete
task.description: Filed from the P6-188 round-2 review (2026-08-09). Three related e2e test-hygiene items now that delete relocates instead of cascading: (1) seven spec files still use one-line delete cleanup helpers that assume cascade — give them the shared deepest-first subtree-aware helper collection-tree-manage.spec.ts now has (the follow-up the P6-188 Findings entry records). (2) scratchName (zz-e2e-${tag}-w${worker}-${seq}) has no wall-clock component, so stranded scratch roots from a failed run collide with the next run's names — collection-header-kebab's find-by-name currently passes by ORDER BY position luck; add a time component. (3) the delete cleanup helper ignores every 4xx (Playwright doesn't throw), silently absorbing real failures — assert on status or log loudly. Specs: specs/collection-deletion.md (Findings), e2e-suite skill conventions.
